name: Will Ventures
identity_check: Boston-based seed firm for consumer, health, sports and entertainment, founded by former football players (TechCrunch, Oct 2022); Fund II $150M. Not Will Capital Management, not Willow or Willo. The firm's own site could not be fetched (will.vc failed); willventures.com loaded but mentions a Los Angeles office and no HQ, so it was not used as a source.
